resources.string: Plug in the adapter with headphones connected.
Connected. Tap Apply to set the volume.
Waiting for Android to connect the audio output…
Pausing playback to apply the volume…
No audio interface in the active configuration.
Audio did not come back. Unplug and replug the headphones.
Playback did not pause. If the sound is gone, pause and resume it.
The adapter\'s own amplifier. 0 dB is its maximum on most adapters; the phone\'s volume buttons still work on top of it.
Runs each time the adapter connects with headphones. Music pauses for about 3 seconds while the volume is set.
Android only lets apps open USB audio devices that can record, such as headsets with a mic, if they have microphone permission. This app never records.
